---
title: "The most huggable penguin species by weight - but in R"
author: "Joyce Lin"
date: 2026-09-24
---

Data: [Palmer Penguins](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/),
Palmer Station Antarctica LTER.

Let's try to find the most sataisfyingly, huggable penguin.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

penguins
head(penguins)
```

```{r}
penguins_species_weight = penguins |> 
  group_by(species) |> 
  summarise(avg_body_mass = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE))
penguins_species_weight
```


label: fig-penguin-mass
fig-cap: "Body mass of penguins by species."

Description: Of the three penguin species observered, the Gentoos are by far the biggest birds and thus, the most satisfyingly huggable ones.
